arxiv-2308-02747.title: SureFED: Robust Federated Learning via Uncertainty-Aware Inward and Outward Inspection
arxiv-2308-02747.creator: Nasimeh Heydaribeni* 1 , Ruisi Zhang* 1 , Tara Javidi 1 , Cristina Nita-Rotaru 2 , Farinaz Koushanfar 1
arxiv-2308-02747.description: Abstract In this work, we introduce SureFED, a novel framework for byzantine robust federated learning. Unlike many existing defense methods that rely on statistically robust quantities, making them vulnerable to stealthy and colluding attacks, SureFED establishes trust using the local information of benign clients. SureFED utilizes an uncertainty aware model evaluation and introspection to safeguard against poisoning attacks.

arxiv-2410-10182.title: Hamiltonian Neural Networks for Robust Out-of-Time Credit Scoring
arxiv-2410-10182.creator: Javier Marín
arxiv-2410-10182.description: A 2024 arXiv research paper by Javier Marín. This paper presents a novel credit scoring approach using neural networks to address class imbalance and out-of-time prediction challenges. We develop a specific optimizer and loss function inspired by Hamiltonian mechanics that better captures credit risk dynamics. Testing on the Freddie Mac Single-Family Loan-Level Dataset shows our model achieves superior discriminative power (AUC) in out-of-time scenarios compared to conventional methods. The approach has consistent performance between in-sample and future test sets, maintaining reliability across time periods.

arxiv-2411-18864.title: Redesigning the ensemble Kalman filter with a dedicated model of epistemic uncertainty
arxiv-2411-18864.creator: Chatchuea Kimchaiwong, Jeremie Houssineau, Adam M. Johansen
arxiv-2411-18864.description: Abstract The problem of incorporating information from observations received serially in time is widespread in the field of uncertainty quantification. Within a probabilistic framework, such problems can be addressed using standard filtering techniques. However, in many real-world problems, some (or all) of the uncertainty is epistemic, arising from a lack of knowledge, and is difficult to model probabilistically.

arxiv-2504-06987.description: Abstract Metabolic Syndrome (MetS) is a cluster of interrelated risk factors that significantly increases the risk of cardiovascular diseases and type 2 diabetes. Despite its global prevalence, accurate prediction of MetS remains challenging due to issues such as class imbalance, data scarcity, and methodological inconsistencies in existing studies.

arxiv-2505-17056.title: Are LLMs Ready for English Standardized Tests? A Benchmarking and Elicitation Perspective
arxiv-2505-17056.creator: Luoxi Tang 1 , Tharunya Sundar 1 , Shuai Yang 1 , Ankita Patra 1 , Manohar Chippada 1 , Giqi Zhao 2 , Yi Li 2 , Riteng Zhang 2 , Tunan Zhao 1 , Ting Yang 1 , Yuqiao Meng 1 , Weicheng Ma 3,4 , Zhaohan Xi 1
arxiv-2505-17056.description: Abstract AI is transforming education by enabling powerful tools that enhance learning experiences. Among recent advancements, large language models (LLMs) hold particular promise for revolutionizing how learners interact with educational content. In this work, we investigate the potential of LLMs to support standardized test preparation by focusing on English Standardized Tests (ESTs).

arxiv-2511-07977.title: Spectral distortions in the decaying QCD dark matter scenario
arxiv-2511-07977.creator: Jorge Mastache, Raúl Henriquez-Ortiz
arxiv-2511-07977.description: Abstract We study the QCD–DM scenario by analyzing the imprint of energy injection from decaying dark-sector particles on the spectral distortions (SDs) of the Cosmic Microwave Background. We adopt a unified framework capable of describing both relativistic and non-relativistic particles, as well as slow and fast decay regimes.

pmc-10607936.description: Children with fetal growth restriction (FGR) and its resultant low birthweight (LBW) are at a higher risk of developing various health problems later in life, including renal diseases, metabolic syndrome, and sarcopenia. pmc-10618543.title: Mathematical modeling of BCG-based bladder cancer treatment using socio-demographics
pmc-10618543.creator: Elizaveta Savchenko, Ariel Rosenfeld, Svetlana Bunimovich-Mendrazitsky
pmc-10618543.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2023). Cancer is one of the most widespread diseases around the world with millions of new patients each year. The current standard treatment for BC follows a routine weekly Bacillus Calmette-Guérin (BCG) immunotherapy-based therapy protocol which is applied to all patients alike.

pmc-10624672.creator: Hailong Ren, Donglin Xu, Wanyu Xiao, Xianyu Zhou, Guangguang Li, Jiwen Zou, Hua Zhang, Zhibin Zhang, Jing Zhang, Yansong Zheng
pmc-10624672.description: Zicaitai is a seasonal vegetable known for its high anthocyanin content in both stalks and leaves, yet its reference genome has not been published to date. Here, we generated the first chromosome-level genome assembly of Zicaitai using a combination of PacBio long-reads, Illumina short-reads, and Hi-C sequencing techniques. The final genome length is 474.

pmc-11443269.title: Effect of Continuous Infusion vs Bolus Dose of Hydrocortisone in Septic Shock: A Prospective Randomized Study
pmc-11443269.creator: Rashmi Salhotra, Ajeeb Sharahudeen, Asha Tyagi, Rajesh S Rautela, Rajit Kemprai
pmc-11443269.description: Aim and backgroundCorticosteroids are recommended for use in adult patients with septic shock requiring vasopressors for blood pressure maintenance. However, this predisposes them to hyperglycemia, which is associated with a poor outcome. This prospective randomized study compares the effect of continuous infusion with bolus hydrocortisone on blood glucose levels in septic shock.

pmc-12904505.title: Chondroid syringoma: Diagnostic challenge with benign mixed tumour of salivary gland—A case report
pmc-12904505.creator: Vinod Mony, Ramadas Madhavan Nirmal, Ramani Lenin Parvathy
pmc-12904505.description: Chondroid syringoma (CS) is a rare benign skin adnexal tumour that may be confused with various skin lesions. This tumour is thought to originate from both secretory and ductal segments of the sweat glands, and both eccrine and apocrine variants have been described. Its occurrence in other parts of body is very rare except in head and neck.

pmc-12959107.title: Concurrent Histoplasmosis & Blastomycosis in a Young Woman
pmc-12959107.creator: Gizem Reyhanoglu, Mohsan Khan, Andrea Venturini
pmc-12959107.description: BackgroundHistoplasmosis capsulatum and Blastomyces dermatitidis are fungi that are uniquely distributed across the United States. Co-infection with both fungi remains uncommon. The literature review of coinfection was limited to three cases. Only two cases were recorded in humans. Infection can yield symptoms ranging from asymptomatic to life-threatening.

pmc-13201326.title: Pilot-scale inoculum-free valorization of raw chicken feathers: ammonium recovery, keratinase production and community dynamics

pmc-13201326.description: Chicken feathers constitute a major keratin-rich agro-industrial residue whose sustainable valorization remains challenging due to the recalcitrant structure of keratin and the energy-intensive nature of conventional treatments. pmc-13322692.title: ChatGPT in Orthopedic Trauma: Consistency, Accuracy, and Agreement With Textbook and Expert Opinion
pmc-13322692.creator: Dror Ronel, Galina Shapiro, Tal Ben Kiki, Yaniv Keren
pmc-13322692.description: BackgroundArtificial intelligence (AI) tools such as ChatGPT are increasingly used in clinical settings, yet their reliability remains unclear.MethodsThis study compared ChatGPT-4o's responses to clinically relevant orthopedic questions on femoral neck and trochanteric fractures with expert consensus and Rockwood and Green's textbook. pmc-13346405.title: FAPI: a solution to all, what about NENs?
pmc-13346405.creator: Ozgul Ekmekcioglu, Filiz Celik, Simon Hughes, Meltem Ocak, Fred Verzijlbergen, Stefano Fanti, Christophe M. Deroose
pmc-13346405.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2026). Fibroblast activation protein (FAP)–targeted PET imaging is an emerging technique that images the tumor stroma by targeting cancer-associated fibroblasts, offering high tumor-to-background contrast and improved lesion detection in tumors with low [¹⁸F]FDG avidity. Given the central role of CAFs in tumor progression and therapy response, FAPI PET has gained interest in neuroendocrine neoplasms (NENs), where stromal imaging may provide complementary information to conventional modalities.

pmc-13474694.creator: Yilin Zhang, Xiaoyun Li, Yifeng Chen, Shanshan Du, Qingyu Li, Yan Yang, Fei He, Zihu Lv, Weimin Ye, Wei Zheng, Jianjun Xiang
